program: PEER Planck+SPT growth and lensing closure

T-GROWTH-002.claim_boundary: Exact CAMB predictions at locally profiled Planck+SPT points. BOSS DR12 uses published marginal f-sigma8 values with stat and systematic errors combined in quadrature and a diagonal diagnostic, not the full correlated likelihood.

T-LENS-001.claim_boundary: The Planck check uses the published one-dimensional lensing-only amplitude combination plus exact CAMB C_L^phiphi morphology. Physical lensing predictions use A_lens=1; fitted CMB smoothing A_lens is recorded separately.

paper_impact: The Planck+SPT preferred PEER cell passes late-time growth and physical-lensing closure. Native axion-EDE is nearly indistinguishable from PEER in growth and lensing, strengthening the interpretation of PEER as a compressed identifiable realization of the same acoustic minimum.
next_gate: Editorial freeze and provenance pass for the microphysics paper. A full correlated BOSS/DESI full-shape and Planck lensing likelihood remains a production statistical refinement, not a blocker for the current microphysics claim.
